study: CARE module-one complete evidence proof and scoped numeric reliability

claims.cpu_diagnostics: Structural logic and deterministic extraction behavior only; not model or clinical accuracy.
claims.cached_replay: Gate and evidence-selection recomputation with unchanged saved applicability labels; no model calls.
claims.new_inference: Requires actual Phi-4/TrialMatchAI and BioLinkBERT-MedNLI run manifest and predictions; a dry-run is not inference.

proof_gate.rule_semantics: main AND NOT(exception_logic), with strong Kleene three-valued logic
proof_gate.proof: exact subset-minimal sufficient assignment of signed atoms under a fixed known rule state
proof_gate.action_opening: rule T and at least one entire sufficient proof has matching, offset-valid, noncontradictory evidence for every atom
proof_gate.unconditional_rule: no patient evidence target; action gate remains closed
proof_gate.unknown_rule: no action gate; no unknown atom may supply a sufficient known proof
proof_gate.limit: 4096 minimal proofs; any overflow fails closed and is explicitly reported
proof_gate.evidence_truth: NLI evidence correctness is not guaranteed by structural proof completeness

numeric_policy.language: English explicit field-anchored measurements; limited Chinese scope markers are accepted but no Chinese measurement grammar is claimed
numeric_policy.subject: explicit patient subject in the same sentence; family/mixed-subject sentence rejected
numeric_policy.time: explicit current marker in same sentence; historical/mixed-time sentence rejected
numeric_policy.uncertainty: negated, corrected or uncertain current patient statement blocks numeric override even if another point exists
numeric_policy.binding: number must follow a supported field alias through a short grammatical bridge
numeric_policy.units: exact decimal factors within supported length/time/count/stage/testosterone/TMB units
numeric_policy.missing_unsupported_or_conflicting: numeric U; retain TrialMatchAI applicability; a numeric context conflict closes the condition evidence gate
numeric_policy.limitations: Conservative pattern-based policy can abstain on valid clinical prose; it is not a general temporal/subject resolver.

data_partitions.synthetic_cpu: Development regression cases designed to exercise known failure modes; not held-out validation.
data_partitions.old_192: Original V6 development cache; 32 case anchors with correlated variants; no independent clinician review.
data_partitions.new_100: Original V6 additional cache; 17 case anchors and 9 rules with controlled variants; no clinician adjudication.
data_partitions.new_model_inputs: Prediction sees only allowlisted structured guidelines, patient text and question; gold/reference structures and structured facts are excluded.

metrics: numeric regression correctness and abstention coverage, with category counts
override on cases whose expected numeric state is U
gate coverage, opened-label accuracy, opened-evidence accuracy and opened-joint accuracy
correct-T gate coverage and incorrect openings
grouped bootstrap descriptive intervals, grouping all case variants by original anchor
parse failures and technical errors counted separately from unknown medical state

held_out_follow_up.split_unit: guideline or rule family, with base case and every variant in the same split
held_out_follow_up.required_labels: T/F/U rule states, condition/exception states, evidence proofs and source spans
held_out_follow_up.clinical_review: Must be actually performed and recorded; no expert review has been claimed for current artifacts.
